Description.SourceString: The stereotype is that wizards are the lazy corner of the combat triangle. They don't have to swing an axe like a melee warrior, or dodge behind mushrooms like a ranger. They stand stock-still, tossing fireballs: a glass cannon who crosses their non-spellcasting fingers, hoping that they don't get impaled on an arrow. But let me tell you: the wizard has to wear the heaviest, most uncomfortable robes, even in the heat of places like the Umbral Sands, and that is hard work. For those wizards, there is nothing like the cool, soothing taste of a cooling arcane infusion.
